recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, blown-out portrait of a person wearing dark sunglasses, framed within a white square border against a black background. The image features a distinct blue-tinted shadow palette and vibrant yellow script typography that overlaps the border edges.
coreVisualRelationships: White frame containing a high-key portrait against a solid black field
Yellow script typography breaking the frame at the top and bottom
Deep indigo/blue shadows contrasting with blown-out white highlights in the face
coreInvariants: High-contrast facial features with minimal mid-tone detail
Dark circular sunglasses as the central focal point
A thin white border separating the subject from the outer black void

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait occupying 80% of the internal white frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, opaque lenses of the sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top yellow text, down to the sunglasses, through the face to the bottom script signature.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black outer margins to compress the central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black background and deep indigo shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Blown-out white for the skin tones and internal frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant golden yellow for the script typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation in the image, offset by high-saturation yellow text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a brush-pen feel
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes with varying thickness
Ascenders and descenders that extend beyond the baseline/x-height significantly
Incorporation of star-like graphic elements on specific letter stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The dot of the 'i' and tops of 't' stems are replaced with four-pointed star shapes

composition.overlap: Overlays the white border and the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for all text elements to maintain a signature-like aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: To capture the specific star-topped stems

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast, blown-out portrait of a person with dark sunglasses, using a duotone palette of white and deep indigo. Place this inside a white square frame, surrounded by a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom golden-yellow script lettering at the top and bottom center, ensuring the letters overlap the white border. Add small four-pointed stars to the tops of vertical stems.

verificationChecks: Does the yellow text overlap the white border?
Is the portrait high-contrast with indigo shadows?
Are there star shapes on the letter stems?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues

avoid: Clean vector edges in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow is vibrant against the black/white
Verify the white frame is distinct
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duotone portrait + white frame + black margins + overlapping yellow script.
